scope: Retrospective diagnostic of three E177 E120 losses0,8,37; three E120 wins9,42,45 as controls.12 exact full-episode replays capture complete MuJoCo integration state. No training, tuning, deployment or new task-success evaluation.
controller: E177 controller/estimators frozen; only passive mj_getState instrumentation added. Both original success/failure trajectories must reproduce exactly.
matched_histories: On every saved pre-action history from both source policies, recompute reference/correction neural ensembles and analytical solve. Score all against the same measured next dq/dx, separating kinematic J*dq error from command-to-motion error. Compare against exact local kinematic Jacobian only as a privileged offline diagnostic, never as policy input.
actions: From identical state/history/goal/context, reconstruct E120, analytical, E120 without its bounded correction, and a privileged local-Jacobian reference. Keep bias, action bounds, aperture, route/guard state, clearance gradient and allowance fixed; use the unchanged safety projection with each candidate metric. Privileged local action is a diagnostic reference, not an optimal-action label.
branches: One40ms step per candidate from the complete saved integration state, including velocities, controls, warm start and other integration fields. Source-policy branch must reproduce saved post-state and contact union. Measure task error reduction, axis error, object displacement, collision and prediction errors. This is a local intervention with source controller context, not a full alternative rollout or proof of eventual task success.
analysis: Primary summaries on states clean before the action, split by source trajectory, phase and loss/win group. All states retained. Report base versus correction and action-projection differences, first divergences, failure chronology and same-state one-step comparisons. No outcome-based controller adjustment.
videos: Full source trajectories for all six cases and both estimators, outcome-labeled and trace/frame/hash verified. Diagnostic branches are not presented as successful full tasks.
